intent.instructions: What is the poster primarily trying to do?

criteria.ask: Asking a question or requesting help/recommendations
criteria.opine: Sharing an opinion, take, or reaction
criteria.inform: Reporting news, facts, or a personal life update
criteria.promote: Selling, promoting, or linking to their own work

criteria.entertainment: Film, TV, music, games, celebrities, fandom

sentiment.instructions: Overall emotional tone of the post

bait.instructions: How hard is this post fishing for engagement?
criteria: Mild hook or call to action

hostile.instructions: The post insults, attacks, or expresses contempt for a person or group

sarcasm.instructions: The post is sarcastic or ironic; it means something other than its literal text

bot.instructions: The post reads like automated or templated output (bot, feed relay, spam) rather than a human typing

nsfw.instructions: The post contains sexual content, slurs, graphic violence, or other material unsuitable for display on a public screen
